content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Mayurbhanj District Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: www.mayurbhanj.odisha.gov.in. Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 30-09-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Mayurbhanj District PGT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form for the Mayurbhanj District PGT Recruitment 2026 is 30 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the PGT posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Post Graduation degree with a minimum of 50% marks in aggregate and must have passed B.Ed. to be eligible for the PGT positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the PGT posts in Mayurbhanj District?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the PGT posts is 62 years. However, retired teachers are eligible to apply up to the age of 65 years.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for PGT posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 13 vacancies for PGT posts in Mayurbhanj District, distributed across various subjects like English, Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the PGT positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary of Rs. 400 per class/period, with a maximum monthly earning not exceeding Rs. 16,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the Mayurbhanj District PGT Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for the PGT posts?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the PGT recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve a Walk-in Interview, followed by Document Verification, and finally the preparation of a Merit List.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I download the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Mayurbhanj District, which is www.mayurbhanj.odisha.gov.in.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to attach self-attested copies of necessary documents, including photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational certificates, along with the filled application form.
